title: Pan-Seared Duck Confit with Russian Kissed Sauce
description: Tangy duck confit meets a rich, Russian-inspired sauce. A perfect combination for a sophisticated dinner.
instructions: 2. Remove the duck confit from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
3. Season the duck confit with salt and black pepper.
4. Dust the duck confit with flour on both sides.
5. Heat the butter and olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Sear the duck confit for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
7. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
8. While the duck is cooking, warm the kissed sauce over low heat.
9. To serve, place the duck confit on a plate and spoon the warmed kissed sauce over the top.
